basis: J.B. Hunt’s April 17, 2023 release established that Q1 2023 consolidated GAAP operating revenue was $3,229,588,000, down 7.42% from $3,488,588,000 in Q1 2022 and below the $3,314,158,600 cutoff. April 17 is the earliest qualifying communication I could verify. The earliest public date remains unresolved because the full management remarks at three intervening investor conferences could not be verified.

coverage.detail: The October 18, 2022 release reported Q3 2022 total operating revenue of $3.84 billion, up 22% year over year. It gave no Q1 2023 consolidated revenue range.
The January 18, 2023 release reported Q4 2022 total operating revenue of $3.65 billion, up 4% year over year. It gave no upper bound for Q1 2023 consolidated revenue.

On the January 18 earnings call, management discussed weak freight demand and the possibility of improvement in Q2. The intermodal growth discussion concerned full-year 2023. The call supplied no numeric upper bound for consolidated Q1 revenue.
The January 24 exhibit disclosed executive compensation. Its 2023 performance measure was annual operating income.
The February 9 Form 8-K disclosed a director’s decision to forgo re-election. It contained no Q1 revenue update.

The issuer lists the February 8 Evercore ISI, March 8 Raymond James and March 14 J.P. Morgan presentations. Its linked replays could not be retrieved, and the available transcript material did not establish the full remarks and Q&A. The archive also lists November 8 Baird and November 15 Stephens presentations in the preceding cycle whose replays could not be retrieved.
The April 3 notice scheduled Q1 results for market close on April 17. It supplied no preliminary revenue figure.

The April 17 release’s GAAP table reports total operating revenue, including fuel surcharges, of 3,229,588 versus 3,488,588 in thousands of dollars for the quarters ended March 31. Its segment reconciliation confirms both consolidated totals after intersegment eliminations. The January transfers were between J.B. Hunt segments.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s Exhibit 99.1 is marked “FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE” and datelined April 17, 2023. Its newsroom independently displays April 17, 2023 as the publication date. This verifies the actual-results date. https://www.jbhunt.com/our-company/newsroom/2023/04/q1-2023-earnings
